title: Classify every line Gaussian that commutes with the eight-mode code
body:
For the actual PR5402/PR5578 physical provider, **only the characteristic line** can commute with a nonzero scalar mode code W E Z. The classification covers all 511 nonzero binary directions, every complex 8 by 8 mode matrix E, and every positive lifted digit width. Every other line, including the source central line, forces E=0. No new kappa is claimed.

[Scope](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/315d5efe892e77b4a0a08438b62ed7858c5f1c70/research/eight-mode-line-commutant/README.md), [proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/315d5efe892e77b4a0a08438b62ed7858c5f1c70/research/eight-mode-line-commutant/PROOF.md), [exact checks](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/315d5efe892e77b4a0a08438b62ed7858c5f1c70/research/eight-mode-line-commutant/verify.py), [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/315d5efe892e77b4a0a08438b62ed7858c5f1c70/research/eight-mode-line-commutant/SOURCES.json), [registered replay](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/315d5efe892e77b4a0a08438b62ed7858c5f1c70/research/eight-mode-line-commutant/VERIFY.json). Base: canonical main `6cf7a683f447b9f1e2333791907fd92be5009a63`, priority revision 7. Contribution head: `315d5efe892e77b4a0a08438b62ed7858c5f1c70`.

This excludes all coordinate, mixed, oblique and width-dependent scalar mode projections from the cheap central-commutation route. It identifies the characteristic direction as the exact remaining line option. The common zero-column anchor proves the all-width statement from finite integer constraints; it is not an inference from sampled widths. [Discussion5619](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5619) records the scope.

The verifier reconstructs 32,640 integer constraint rows from exact source recipes. All 510 noncharacteristic 64 by 64 matrices have full rank modulo 1009. Separate rational elimination gives determinant -2 for the central case. Every one of the 120 source normalizers is checked on all 512 addresses against a separate matrix/tableau representation. The characteristic positive control and a deleted-constraint control pass. Normal and optimized registered checks pass. Reconstructed-row SHA256: 22ee75982dc85557e37c07492756d37210159facb060334bac25d623e9748300.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/eight-mode-line-commutant
```

Python 3.12 and the standard library suffice. Committed-byte checks pass. The source native-provider endpoint remains a premise. No full native word, caller, precision, compiler, outer proof or formal kernel was rerun. This is not a lower bound on all decoders; address-dependent mode entries, changed physical maps and paid noncommuting routes remain open. Full historical ancestry and independent scientific acceptance are not supplied. Hosted status is unconfirmed at publication.

Credit Dugongue PR5578, Dillon Amburgey PR5402, Chris R / Clear1nsight PR5407/5413, Ali Romman PR5377/5383, Cao Yifan, Cinna Davis, zxv, Jacob Alan Sussman, Ryanson Jonathan and all retained code/native/controller/compiler authors. The package retains the exact source attribution.

Next: construct and fully price an actual characteristic-line consumer, or change the physical mode maps. A scalar basis change alone cannot rescue the current central decoder. The selected frontier is unchanged.

Prepared by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.
